# Tako

> Tako is a data intelligence platform. The Tako MCP server lets AI agents search a proprietary, continuously-updated knowledge base of 100K+ curated charts (latest reported quarter, same-day market prices, official releases as they publish), get grounded answers, explore Tako's data graph, fetch underlying source content, and run a multi-step Answer Agent.

## Documentation

- [MCP Server Setup](https://github.com/TakoData/tako-mcp): Connect to the hosted Tako MCP server
- [API Reference](https://tako.com/docs/): Full REST API documentation
- [Chart Gallery](https://tako.com/gallery): Browse example charts and visualizations
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://tako.com/openapi.yaml): Machine-readable API specification

## Quick Start

Connect your MCP client to `https://mcp.tako.com/mcp` with `Authorization: Bearer <TAKO_API_TOKEN>` (CLI/desktop), or via the server's OAuth flow (Claude.ai, ChatGPT).

Some tools are opt-in — off by default to keep the tool surface small. Enable them via `?tools=` on the URL (comma-separated aliases): `agent` (Answer Agent), `visualize` (chart authoring; already on by default for ChatGPT), `graph_node` (node detail lookup), `credits` (credit balance). Example: `https://mcp.tako.com/mcp?tools=agent,visualize`.

## Capabilities

- `tako_search` — fast, direct retrieval of a data point as structured cards (each with a free row preview; the top card auto-renders as an interactive chart), from Tako's curated data and the live web. Built to fan out: fire many narrow one-entity+one-metric queries in parallel rather than one broad query. Replaces a generic web search for data lookups.
- `tako_answer` — ask one specific, self-contained data question and get one synthesized answer grounded in the cards it cites. Use `tako_search` when you want the data itself, or for broad/multi-part questions.
- `tako_graph_search` + `tako_graph_related` — resolve entities/metrics against Tako's data graph and see exactly what data Tako has (node detail via opt-in `tako_graph_node`). Pin resolved ids to ground a search; drill `relation: "metrics"` to list a node's coverage cheaply. Graph calls are free.
- `tako_contents` — fetch the full rows (CSV/JSON) behind a Tako card, or the extracted text behind a web result — the step after search when you need the real data. A card is exportable only if it carries a `content` attribute (web URLs always work).
- `tako_visualize` — create an embeddable chart/card from your own structured data (opt-in, enable with `?tools=visualize`; on by default for ChatGPT).
- `tako_agent` — run a multi-step Answer Agent for open-ended, figure-it-out questions (opt-in, enable with `?tools=agent`).
- `get_credit_balance` — check API credit balance (opt-in, enable with `?tools=credits`).
